Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Kavita - 42 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Vikram - 43 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Vihaan - 10 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
5. Vimla - 67 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Kavita and Vikram stand near him.]

Kavita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ishaan smiles at Mother.]

Ishaan (softly): "Exactly right."

[Ishaan lights a diya.]

Ishaan: "That's great!"

[Ishaan coughs.]

Ishaan: "Show me too!"

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Ishaan: "One more time!"

[Ishaan feeds the dog.]

Vikram: "This is amazing!"

[Ishaan milks the cow.]

Vikram (surprised): "That was such a fun day!"
